blocks.title: Permanent dipole-permanent dipole force
blocks.text: Ek polar molecule ke musbat (positive) sire aur paas wale polar molecule ke manfi (negative) sire ke darmiyan kashish ko permanent dipole-permanent dipole force kehte hain.

Jab HCl ke molecules ek doosre ke qareeb hon (jaise liquid state mein), to woh Figure 5.3 ki tarah ek qatar (line) mein lag jate hain: ek ka H (δ+) agle ke Cl (δ−) ki taraf. Isi qisam ki forces chloroform (CHCl₃) ke molecules mein bhi hoti hain.
Chloroform ke molecule ka musbat markaz (centre) H atom par aur manfi markaz Cl atoms wale sire par hota hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: qatar mein chaar gulabi polar molecules, har ek par baen taraf δ+ aur daen taraf δ-. Darmiyan: H-Cl, H-Cl, H-Cl ek seedh mein, har H par δ+ aur har Cl par δ-, har Cl se agle molecule ke H tak dashed lakeer. Neeche: chloroform ke do molecules, Cl3C-H; pehle ka H (δ+) dashed lakeer se doosre ke Cl (δ-) se juda, aur doosre ka H δ+ hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.3: HCl aur chloroform mein permanent dipole-permanent dipole forces (kitab ki Figure 5.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har polar molecule ek chhote magnet jaisa hai jis ke do sire hain (δ+ aur δ−). Ulte sire ek doosre ko khinchte hain, is liye molecules sir se paon tak qatar mein lag jate hain. Yeh forces London forces se mazboot magar hydrogen bond se kamzor hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: HCl ke molecules liquid mein qatar mein kyun lag jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Cl, H se zyada electronegative hai, is liye H par δ+ aur Cl par δ− charge hai. Ek molecule ka δ+ H agle molecule ke δ− Cl ko khinchta hai, is liye molecules musbat-se-manfi qatar mein lag jate hain.

items: Permanent dipole-permanent dipole force: ek polar molecule ka musbat sira agle ke manfi sire ko khinchta hai; HCl aur chloroform (CHCl₃) is tarah qatar mein lagte hain.
